requirements.text: A new bookmark shall be added into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.
Bookmarks shall be properly deleted from bookmarks file and no longer be displayed  from all access points.
Bookmarks shall be added and deleted from the personal toolbar.
New bookmark folder shall be inserted into the bookmarks hierarchy.
Double-clicking on a bookmark shall cause it to be launched in a browser window.
Bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser shall be valid links.
Changes to a bookmark item shall be saved without loss of item integrity.
Bookmarks separators shall be added and deleted.
Bookmarks changes shall be saved over restart/crash.
View properties shall execute for bookmarks, folders, and separators(negative).
Bookmarks shall be renamed "inline", i.e. without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.
Bookmarks shall be found using user-defined custom keyword.
Bookmarks shall be sorted and reverse-sorted per column.
Bookmark columns shall be resizable to show/hide more of entries.
Bookmark columns shall be showed and hidden.
Several bookmarks shall be deleted at one time.
It shall be not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself or its immediate parent or child.

generated_cases.title: Add new bookmark into a specific subfolder

generated_cases.title: Add new bookmark into a deeply nested folder
generated_cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark is successfully added into a deeply nested folder within the hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Attempt to add bookmark with invalid URL
generated_cases.description: Verify that adding a bookmark with an invalid or malformed URL is handled appropriately or rejected.

generated_cases.title: Delete an existing bookmark
generated_cases.description: Verify that an existing bookmark can be properly deleted from the bookmarks file and is no longer displayed from all access points.

generated_cases.title: Delete the last remaining bookmark
generated_cases.description: Verify that deleting the final remaining bookmark successfully removes it from the bookmarks file and all access points without leaving residual UI artifacts.

generated_cases.title: Delete a bookmark currently open in a tab
generated_cases.description: Verify the boundary scenario of deleting a bookmark whose target webpage is currently open in an active browser tab.

generated_cases.title: Delete a non-existent bookmark

generated_cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into hierarchy
generated_cases.description: Insert a new bookmark folder into a specific valid location within the bookmarks hierarchy and verify it is successfully added.

generated_cases.title: Insert empty bookmark folder
generated_cases.description: Insert a new bookmark folder with no items inside into the bookmarks hierarchy and verify correct creation.

generated_cases.title: Insert folder at maximum allowed nesting depth
generated_cases.description: Insert a new bookmark folder at the maximum allowed nesting depth boundary in the bookmarks hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Abnormal insert folder with duplicate name
generated_cases.description: Attempt to insert a new bookmark folder with a duplicate name inside the same parent folder and verify that the system handles the conflict or rejects it appropriately.

generated_cases.title: Launch Bookmark in Browser Window
generated_cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark successfully causes it to be launched in a browser window.

generated_cases.title: Verify default bookmarks contain valid links

generated_cases.title: Verify default bookmarks with redirect URLs

generated_cases.description: Attempt to save bookmark edits while simulating a sudden storage write failure, and verify that item integrity is preserved or corruption is avoided.

generated_cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder can be successfully deleted from the hierarchy.

generated_cases.title: Delete folder containing multiple subfolders and items
generated_cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder containing multiple subfolders and items is completely removed along with its contents.

generated_cases.title: Delete a system-locked folder
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to delete a system-locked bookmarks folder fails and preserves the folder.

generated_cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark Separators Normal Scenario

generated_cases.description: Verify that executing view properties on a mixed selection containing bookmarks, folders, and separators behaves correctly according to negative constraints.

reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have a bookmarks file.
2. To promote consistency, you may choose to use the default set of Netscape Seamonkey Bookmarks, which I use. I have also provided the default Mozilla bookmarks file.
3. You also have the option to use this very large bookmarks file.
4. You must also customize your sidebar to include a bookmarks panel.

reference_cases.title: TC-014
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. Install this bookmarks file.(abcdbookmarks.html)
2. You must also customize your sidebar to include a bookmarks panel.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Bookmarks|Manage Bookmarks.
2. Click on the "Name" column once.
3. Click on the "Name" column a second time.
4. Click on the "Name" column a third time.
5. Click on the "URL" column once, and a second time.
6. Click on the "Custom Keyword" column once, and a second time.
7. Click on the "Description" column once, and a second time.
8. Click on the "Last Visit" column once, and a second time.
9. Click on the "Added On" column once, and a second time.
10. Click on the "Last Modified" column once, and a second time.

EXPECTED RESULTSBy step
1. The bookmarks should sort into alphabetical order. (a-b-c-d-e)
2. The bookmarks should sort into reverse-alphabetical order. (e-d-c-b-a)
3. The bookmarks should sort into "natural" order (the way they were originally sorted). (a-d-e-b-c)
4. The bookmarks should sort into order by URL and then the reverse of that order. (d-a-b-c-e)
5. The bookmarks should sort into order by Custom Keyword and then the reverse of that order. (c-d-a-b-e)
6. The bookmarks should sort into order by Description and then the reverse of that order. (b-c-d-a-e)
7. The bookmarks should sort into order by Last Visited time and then the reverse of that order.
8. The bookmarks should sort into order by Added On date and then the reverse of that order.
9. The bookmarks should sort into order by Last Modified date and then the reverse of that order.
10. Separators should separate the sort as well, ie step one should result in a-b-c-d-e|aa-bb-cc-dd-ee, not a-aa-b-bb-c-cc-d-dd-e|.

LINKS
1. netscape-bookmarks.html
2. mozilla-bookmarks.html
3. large-bookmarks.html

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select the toplevel "Bookmarks" menu. Select Bookmarks|Manage Bookmarks.
2. Select any bookmark. Shift+click or drag to select more (at least 3).

reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have a bookmarks file.
2. To promote consistency, you may choose to use the default set of Netscape Seamonkey Bookmarks, which I use. I have also provided the default Mozilla bookmarks file.
3. You also have the option to use this very large bookmarks file.
4. You must also customize your sidebar to include a bookmarks panel.
5. As part of your bookmarks file you need a folder (lets' call it folder "A") that contains bookmarks and another folder (let's call this folder "A1" (read Asub1)) that contains bookmarks as well.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Bookmarks|Manage Bookmarks.
2. Select folder A1 then drag&drop it onto or within itself
3. Select folder A1 then drag&drop it onto or within folder A.
4. Select folder A then drag&drop it onto or within folder A1.
5. Select a bookmark within folder A1 and drop it onto folder A1.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. Nothing should happen! No bookmark or folder should be moved in any of these cases. Ideally, one should see the International symbol for "No" cursor.
